added.summary: Exported from the components barrel; they were reachable only by deep import.
`onNavigate` reports the normalized point pressed or dragged across the map, and `onPing` the point of a long press; both are clamped to 0..1.
`previousLabel` and `nextLabel` name the arrow keys for a screen reader; absent, they keep the navigation's label (Pagination) or the month (Calendar).

added.member: Waypoint, Nameplate, SpeechBubble, InteractionPrompt, LootLabel, OverheadBars
added.summary: Take the world-anchor scaling and `occlusion` (`fade`, `hide` or `none`) props; Waypoint and Compass markers take `elevation` (`above`, `below`, `level`) and draw a chevron for it.

fixed.summary: The default look is consistent: radii come from the radius tokens (no `nine-socket` cuts or fixed corners left), display type no longer uses `tracking-tight`, keycaps use `text-key-fg` on the key gradient, accent text uses `text-accent-ink`, and rows that were missing `flex-row` lay out in a row again (Card, FlowChartScreen, ResultsScreen, LoadingScreen, RpgCrafting, PuzzleSummary, Reveal).

The `back` action reports onResume or onBack. Danger rows on the pause menu fill in the danger colour with its ink rather than red text on the accent. Save/Load's Delete is a danger button, and Delete and Load are disabled with no saved slot selected.

fixed.member: ResultsScreen, LeaderboardScreen, LoadingScreen, PauseScreen, HudEditorScreen, Subtitles
fixed.summary: Content stays inside the HUD safe area (`env(hud-inset-*)` plus the screen's own padding); HudEditorScreen's trailing `p-4` no longer overrode the insets. Subtitles take no presses.
Ranks are written `#1,284` in the player's locale instead of English ordinals, and second place is legible (it was gold ink on white).
The lit objective is the first one not done, even when an earlier one is still open; progress is clamped to 0..1.
The column count follows `columns` instead of a fixed three.
A leaf keeps its twisty's room with an inert spacer instead of an invisible button that still took focus.
Shows the slide `index` names; it always showed the first.

Cooldowns, timers and status durations show tenths under ten seconds; StatBar, BossBar and cooldown wipes guard a zero maximum; RadialMeter fills in order; QtePrompt and Combo no longer draw debug labels; Killfeed marks the player's own rows; DamageNumbers draws misses, heals and crits and takes no presses; HoldButton needs the full hold.
